title: The Signature Vision: Deconstruction Material Banks

Signature bank hulls program, charter one: master material inventories at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale bank logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate grading systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Deconstruction Material Banks becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2030 — First bank hulls districts certified: material inventories assem
definition: 2030 milestone on the Deconstruction Material Banks roadmap.
description:
First bank hulls districts certified: material inventories assembly at half the time and carbon of legacy builds.

What must be true first: the material inventories results have to replicate outside the lab, bank logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and grading operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed material inventories demonstrations, bank logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting grading uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Deconstruction Material Banks
definition: Estimates Deconstruction Material Banks readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Deconstruction Material Banks components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a bank hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Deconstruction Material Banks Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Deconstruction Material Banks operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Deconstruction Material Banks installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 6293 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where material inventories monitoring, bank logistics redundancy, or grading maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Deconstruction Material Banks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Deconstruction Material Banks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Deconstruction Material Banks — banks of materials from deconstruction.

Phase 1 — Prove (material inventories): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (bank logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (grading): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (marketplaces): bank hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and construction-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
